Definition: accusative case plural of G1473; us:--our, us, we.
BiblicalUsage: Hemas is us in the accusative, the us that things are done to, and the prayers of the Bible are full of it. In Matthew 6:13 Jesus teaches us to pray, deliver us from evil, in Matthew 8:29 the devils cry, art thou come hither to torment us, and in Matthew 9:27 two blind men cry, have mercy on us.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the prayer is the pattern: deliver us, have mercy on us; the us is the church praying together, and the deliverance is the answer.
